Hi Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler rejected both the list and create requests with a Gateway credentials error (`gateway cron.add requires credentials`), so nothing is scheduled yet. Someone with Gateway admin access will need to fix the scheduler auth before I can create it.

Once it's working, the job would run Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 19 October. It would post in #coastal-team using only that channel and #coastal-random, which have the same members. It would leave out finance figures and finance documents, so no rates, discounts, or contract values would appear.
